bio.text: Eric Flores, a Republican Army veteran and lawyer from Mission, announced in July 2025 that he was running for Texas's 34th Congressional District.

He previously served as a city attorney and municipal judge in Alton, and from 2021 to early 2025 was an assistant U.S. attorney in the criminal division of the Southern District of Texas in McAllen, according to The Texas Tribune.
The Tribune also describes him as a native of the Rio Grande Valley.

sources.title: GOP Army veteran announces challenge to Democrat Vicente Gonzalez in South Texas congressional district
